sentences.text: This matter is taken up through hybrid mode.

01.
2. Heard Mr. B.K. Nayak, learned counsel for the petitioner and Mr. P.K. Muduli, learned Additional Government Advocate for the State.
3.
The petitioner has filed this writ petition seeking direction to the opposite parties to consider and dispose of the petition filed by him under Section 28-A of the Land Acquisition Act.

4. Mr. Nayak, learned counsel for the petitioner contended that the petitioner is entitled to get some compensation and for that purpose, he approached the Special Land Acquisition Officer, Khariar under Annexure- 1 series by filing a petition under Section 28-A of the Land Acquisition Act, but the same has not yet been disposed of.

5. Mr. P.K. Muduli, learned Additional Government Advocate contended that the petitioner filed the petition under section 28-A of the Land Acquisition Act only in the month of December 2022 and now in the month of April he wants for disposal of the same on priority basis.

He further contended that there may be many other people waiting for disposal of their petition and in case any direction is issued to the Special LAO, Khariar for early disposal of the petition of the petitioner on priority basis, then such persons will be prejudiced.
6.

Having heard learned counsel for the parties and after going through the records, since the petitioner seeks direction for early disposal of the petition filed under Section 28-A of the LA Act,
this Court is not inclined to grant any such direction at this stage.

However, liberty is granted to the petitioner to file an application before the Special LAO, Khariar for early disposal of his petition Nibash Sahu vs State Of Odisha And Others ..... ... on 20 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/158857557/
1 under Section 28-A of the LA Act and in case such an application is filed, the same shall be considered and disposed of in accordance with law.
7.
